question.problem:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. $\text{gcd}(888,205)=7$

II. $\text{gcd}(888,205)=1$

III. $888$ and $205$ are coprime
question.worked_solution:
Recall that two integers are coprime if their greatest common divisor is $1.$ 

With that in mind, let's examine our statements in turn.

- Statement I is false, while statement II is true. Indeed, let's use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}888 & = & 205\cdot 4 & + & 68 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 205 & = & 68\cdot 3 & + & 1 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 68 & = & 1\cdot 68 & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $1.$ So, the greatest common divisor of $888$ and $205$ is $1:$

$$
\text{gcd}(888,205)=1.
$$

- Statement III is true. Since $\text{gcd}(888,205)=1,$ the numbers are coprime.

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only."
